overview.value: MDA Space Ltd. is a Canadian space technology company headquartered in Brampton, Ontario, Canada, that provides geointelligence, robotics, space operations, and satellite systems. John S. MacDonald and Vern Dettwiler founded MacDonald, Dettwiler and Associates in the basement of MacDonald's Vancouver home in 1969. On 7 April 2021, MDA became a publicly traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange trading under the symbol MDA.

focus.value: Robotics, satellite systems, and geointelligence pioneer serving the global defence and space industry

events.headline: John MacDonald and Vern Dettwiler found MacDonald, Dettwiler and Associates
